column1: # Basic foods without a barcode. Values come from USDA FoodData Central, SR Legacy (public domain, CC0).
# Columns (tab-separated): fdc_id, Italian name, category, unit (g|ml), serving size, serving label.
# Serving sizes are typical Italian portions chosen for this app, not USDA data.
# Drinks use ml: USDA values are per 100 g, which for these liquids is within a few percent of 100 ml.
# Rebuild src/data/generic-foods.json with: python3 scripts/generic-foods/build.py <USDA SR Legacy CSV folder>
